Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Rakesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel appearing for respondent no.2 and the learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners states that the petitioners in the instant petition also ought to be given the benefits which flow out of Section 31 of the Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act').
